title: IBM Process Mining 2.0.0 through 2.2.1 could allow an authenticated attacker to cause a denial of service through…
description: IBM Process Mining versions 2.0.0 through 2.2.1 contain a vulnerability that allows an authenticated attacker to cause a denial of service by exploiting insufficient rate limiting on email notifications. This flaw can result in excessive emails being sent to targeted recipients, potentially overwhelming email systems or users.
